title: Chess Cinema director evaluation label
description: One human-labelled verdict about what the cinematic director chose for one game. Machine-derived fields are refreshed by buildLabels.mjs from the corpus capture; human fields are never overwritten by tooling.

game_id.description: Stable id. For run games this is the PGN filename without extension.

status.description: awaiting-pgn: known game, PGN not yet supplied, nothing captured. captured-unlabelled: pipeline output captured, human verdict still missing. labelled: a human has filled in the verdict fields.

game_type.description: Used by report.mjs to break failure patterns down by kind of game.

pgn_file.description: Repo-relative path to the .pgn, or null while status is awaiting-pgn.

termination_type.description: checkmate / stalemate / resignation / draw-agreed / timeout / unterminated / other

actual_important_event.description: HUMAN. What actually mattered in this game, in your words. The ground truth the director is being graded against.

missed_events.description: HUMAN. Things that mattered but the director did not surface at all.

tool_selected_moments.description: MACHINE. Copied from the capture: the Moments the director actually chose.

tool_caption_text.description: MACHINE. Exactly the caption strings export/drawCaptions.ts burns into the video.

tool_story_primary_ply.description: MACHINE. The ply the story layer called decisive.

tool_top_raw_swing_ply.description: MACHINE. The ply with the largest raw Stockfish evaluation swing.

tool_terminal_ply.description: MACHINE. The last played ply of the game.

tool_camera_focus_plies.description: MACHINE. Plies the camera zoomed on.

caption_correct.description: HUMAN. Did the caption text describe what really happened?

camera_correct.description: HUMAN. Did the camera frame the right part of the board at the right time?

sequence_correct.description: HUMAN. Was the multi-move sequence kept intact rather than collapsed to one move?

causally_correct.description: HUMAN. Was the cause linked to its later effect (e.g. early blunder -> later mate)?

verdict.description: HUMAN. Overall judgement of the story the director told.

failure_category.description: HUMAN. Null when verdict is 'correct'. 'other' requires failure_category_other.

failure_category_other.description: HUMAN. Free text, only when failure_category is 'other'.

notes.description: HUMAN. Anything else worth remembering about this game.

capture_file.description: MACHINE. Path of the capture JSON this record was refreshed from.
